help: The proposed time is selected by default. You can change it before confirming the content and authorizing delivery.
forecast: This possibility does not reserve a time slot. Availability will be checked during preparation and authorization.
loading: Loading this dossier’s proposed times and publications…
loadFailed: Proposals are unavailable. Refresh their status before reviewing them.
missingDelivery: This publication is no longer available in this dossier. Refresh the proposals before continuing.
prepareConfirm: Prepare drafts for all eligible dossiers on this destination? This action does not publish anything or authorize delivery.

chain.title: Publication guideposts
chain.help: Choose a social benefit to review its content, administrative sending authorization, publication and evidence. The offer and preparation remain dossier-wide. Viewing does not authorize sending.
chain.chooseHelp: No benefit is selected. These guideposts do not choose a delivery for you. The website profile remains available in its card below.
chain.selectedHelp: These guideposts retain this source, its delivery and its benefit when they are linked. Sending authorization is decided in the publication tool, without creating client consent.
chain.unavailable: The requested guidepost is no longer available or its identifiers do not match. Choose a source present in this dossier; no other delivery was opened.
chain.noExactEvidence: This source is not linked to an exact promised benefit: use the dossier’s full progress view to look for its evidence.
chain.noDelivery: No delivery is linked to this source. Prepare a proposal in its card before reviewing sending authorization or publication.
chain.regionUnavailable: This section is unavailable for the current state or permissions. The exact publication remains open for review; no decision was made.

opened.content: Reading the selected delivery’s saved content. Corrections and saving remain in this tool.
opened.authorization: Reviewing this delivery’s administrative sending authorization. Opening it approves nothing; the usual checks and confirmation are still required.
opened.delivery: Reviewing the selected delivery’s destination, mode and status. Only a confirmed result establishes delivery.

chain.contentTarget: Content, website visibility and social authorization

workflow.title: Promised benefits and next steps
workflow.help: You review and authorize the content. The platform publishes at the scheduled time and automatically confirms each benefit after success.

responsibility.none: No remaining action for this benefit.

reason.commitment_needs_confirmation: Document the original agreement’s promised benefits before preparing publication.
reason.publication_retry_pending: The platform has scheduled a retry
reason.publication_pending: Review needed · a historical declaration does not prove delivery

reasons.publication_preparation_required: Prepare the publication promised in the agreement before reviewing its final content.
reasons.publication_authorization_required: Review and authorize the exact content, destination and date. The platform will then publish it.
reasons.publication_scheduled: The publication is authorized and scheduled. The platform will publish it and record delivery after success.
reasons.publication_publishing: The platform is publishing. Wait for the result before taking further action.
reasons.publication_retry_pending: The platform has scheduled a retry after a confirmed failure. Follow its result.
reasons.publication_paused: The destination is paused. Review its settings to resume the authorized publication.
reasons.publication_worker_disabled: The worker is stopped. Review its settings before resuming authorized publications.
reasons.publication_simulation: The simulation is complete. Authorize an actual publication to deliver the promised benefit.
reasons.publication_failed: Publication failed. Review the result and recovery conditions without republishing benefits already delivered.
reasons.publication_uncertain: The publication result is uncertain. Reconcile it before any new attempt.

paymentJourney.platformWaiting: The platform handles the scheduled publication and confirms delivery after success. You can refresh its status.

commitments.historicalHelp: Find the original contract, email or agreement and record the promised benefits: channel, destination, quantity and format. The evidence requested here establishes the agreement, not an already successful publication. Benefits cannot be inferred from the amount paid.
commitments.evidenceReference: Internal reference to the contract or email establishing the agreement

publicationBridge.intro: The platform executes authorized calendar publications and records delivery after success. See each promised benefit, its progress and the next step here.

blocker.commitment_needs_confirmation: Document the promised benefits using the original contract or email

status.prepared: Draft prepared · final publication needs composition

publicationBridge.commitmentUnknown: This dossier has no recorded original agreement. Document the promised benefits using a contract or email; evidence of an already delivered publication is not requested at this step.
publicationBridge.confirmDeclaration: Record this historical publication declaration? No publication will be sent and no benefit will be marked delivered.
publicationBridge.completedBenefits: Benefits closed with evidence or waiver
publicationBridge.historicalDeclaration: These settings retain historical tracking. Declaring “published” does not send anything or confirm a delivered benefit. Use the scheduled publications above to authorize an actual publication.

publications.finalAuthorizationRequired: Review and authorize the final publication in the automation workspace. The platform will confirm delivery after a successful publication.
